name: Mountain Pass Overlook
description: A shelf of rock above the pass, scattered with wind-bent pines. On a clear day you can see clear down to Goldenhaven.

discovery.message: A goat track leaves the road and climbs to a wide shelf of rock overlooking the pass.

overlook.text: The wind tugs at your cloak. Below, the pass winds away between the peaks; behind you, the pines lean all one way.

choices.label: Follow the fresh hoofprints into the pines.
Head back down to the road.

the-view.text: Far below, a caravan crawls toward Goldenhaven, its wagons no bigger than beetles. Up here it is very quiet.

hoofprints.text: Small, neat hoofprints, and a trail of dropped turnips. Ahead, something brays in terror, and something else answers it with a growl.

the-pack.text: Two grey wolves have a fat little mule backed against a boulder. They turn on you, hackles up.

the-leader.text: A wolf the size of a pony pads out of the pines, the pack's leader, and it is not afraid of you at all.

buttercup.text: Buttercup is shaking but whole, her panniers still strapped on and only a little chewed. She lets you take her lead rope, then tries to eat your sleeve.

leave.text: You pick your way back down the goat track to the road.
